title: Capability-Separated Clearance Live Probe
claim: FP-MCP-346 establishes a non-executing live probe packet for testing the capability-separated clearance MCP surface.
summary: Create a packet checkpoint so structured approval and intent artifacts can be recorded under a known packet id during live probing of observe, preview, and clearance intent tools.
caveats: This packet does not create clearance.
This packet does not enable execution.
This packet does not call the deprecated guarded apply wrapper.
This packet does not contact runner start or start OpenCode.
observedResult: FP-MCP-346 establishes a non-executing live probe packet for testing the capability-separated clearance MCP surface.
